verdict.rationale: Unleash documents self-hosting both its Open Source and Enterprise editions in your own environment with Docker, including cloning the repo and starting the server with Docker Compose. A community recommendation as an open-source, self-hosted LaunchDarkly alternative corroborates this. missing for 10: in-depth production self-hosting guidance in the evidence (e.g., database/scaling/upgrade docs), hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.
To start the Unleash server, clone the Unleash repository and start the server with Docker Compose
Asked for an open-source, self-hosted alternative to LaunchDarkly, a commenter recommended Unleash (github.com/Unleash/unleash).
